featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash is a great place if you’re looking for a solid gaming and entertainment experience. From bowling and cricket to go-karting, there’s a good mix of activities that can easily keep you engaged for 5–6 hours.

They also have 3–4 good VR experiences that are definitely worth trying. The arcade games are decent, but you can skip a few of them and spend that time (and money) on the bigger experiences instead.

The space is well laid out, and even when it gets busy, the crowd feels manageable. Another plus is that the food here is good, making it easy to take breaks between games without stepping out.

One tip — check for combo packages or offers before you start playing. They can help you save a fair bit compared to paying for individual games.

Overall, it’s a fun spot for a long outing with friends or family.

We discovered YEY Yaya Kids Club while we were in Bombay for shopping. My wife and I had our little one with us and he was getting bored, so we decided to try this place for about 1.5 hours (₹650) and honestly, it was completely worth every rupee.

The place is very well equipped and thoughtfully designed for kids. They also have a big indoor play area, in-house café, and even paid games for extra fun. The space is clean, safe, colourful and very well managed. You can also host birthday parties here which we noticed a lot of parents doing, it’s a perfect setup for that.

What I really liked is that it gives parents a break while kids are happily engaged in a proper play environment. For us, it turned a tiring shopping day into a smooth one because our kid came out smiling and exhausted in the best way 😄

If you’re in Bombay with kids, this place is a life-saver.
Highly recommended. We’ll definitely be coming back. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Gerry Savage
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited on a weekday (Wednesday) but were charged the weekend entry price without any prior notice. It was not a government or national holiday. After being charged, I noticed the bill listed a weekend rate, and when I questioned it, I was told it was because of Pongal (which is not a national holiday). There were no signs, notices, or verbal mention before payment that weekend pricing would apply.
There are excessive restrictions throughout the facility (what children can do, what they can play with, and even how they’re allowed to play). In the pretend play area, costumes are not allowed to be removed from the spot and are only permitted for photos. My child was asked to remove a costume, yet there is no signage explaining this rule. If the area is for photos only, that should be clearly stated.
In the arcade, you only get one play. Several amenities were also not functioning, including the crane game and the rock-climbing area. Other areas were taped up, torn, or visibly run down, making the place feel poorly maintained and potentially unsafe.
There are also rules about where adults are allowed, but no clear indication of which areas are restricted. Overall, the staff managed the space in a very stern manner, which is not appropriate for a children’s play area.
Between the misleading weekday pricing, excessive and unclear rules, broken attractions, and poor maintenance, the experience was extremely disappointing. What was supposed to be a fun outing for my three-year-old turned into a frustrating and unpleasant experience. At best, the practices feel dishonest.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

I visited this place on a recommendation with my cousin’s kids and honestly it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience. The moment you enter you’re welcomed by different animal structures and statues, the entire space is beautifully designed with a jungle theme. Every corner looks vibrant and thoughtfully created, making it perfect for kids who love animals.

What really stood out to me was the mix of fun and learning. They have interactive setups like a bank counter, kitchen area, shopping mall and even a doctor’s clinic, which makes it engaging for kids while also being educational. There are plenty of activities to keep them busy along with cute rides and play areas.

The highlight has to be the crazy maze castle, it’s honestly something you need to experience to understand how exciting it is. I genuinely felt like I wish I was a kid again to enjoy it fully, even adults can have a great time here watching and being part of the fun.

Another thing I really appreciated is how many staff members are always around. They are very attentive and make sure the kids are safe and enjoying at all times. Even if you’re busy or just want to relax for a bit, you can trust them to take good care of your kids. It definitely feels like a very safe and well-managed environment.

They also have a very cute café serving pure vegetarian food. We tried pizza, pasta, fries, boba drinks and coffee, everything was quite good and perfect after all the activities.

I also got to know that the place can be booked for kids’ birthday parties and celebrations, which honestly makes it even more special.

Overall it’s truly a unique experience and definitely one of Mumbai’s first jungle adventure themed parks. I would highly recommend this place to anyone with kids, it’s something they’re going to absolutely love

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Kinkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Timezone at Phoenix Palladium is hands-down one of the best spots in Mumbai for a fun day out. Tucked away on the Third Floor of the East Wing, it is incredibly easy to find and offers a massive variety of games that keep both kids and adults thoroughly entertained.The arcade selection here is top-notch. They have the latest immersive VR games like Virtual Rabbids and Dark Mars VR, which are absolutely thrilling. Beyond video games, the social play options are fantastic. We had an incredible time hitting the bowling lanes and driving the bumper cars, making it the perfect spot to hang out with a group of friends or family. It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. It gets busy on weekends, but the weekday deals make it completely worth a mid-week visit. Highly recommended!
